import java.util.*;

public class Main {
    static final int[][] c = {{-1,0},{1,0},{0,-1},{0,1}};
    static int S, T, tot = 1, n, tt, inf;
    static int[] b = new int[1000];
    static int[] q = new int[1000000];
    static int[][] a = new int[1000000][3];
    static int[][] dep = new int[20][20];
    static int[][] dis = new int[20][20];
    static int[][] p = new int[20][20];
    static int[][] s = new int[20][20];
    static char[][] ma = new char[20][20];
    static char[][] mb = new char[20][20];

    static void add(int x, int y, int c) {
        a[++tot][0] = y;
        a[tot][1] = c;
        a[tot][2] = b[x];
        b[x] = tot;

        a[++tot][0] = x;
        a[tot][1] = 0;
        a[tot][2] = b[y];
        b[y] = tot;
    }

    static void bfs(int x0, int y0, boolean flag) {
        int l, r, id = p[x0][y0];
        q[l = r = 1] = x0 * 1000 + y0;
        
        for (int i = 0; i < 20; i++) {
            Arrays.fill(dis[i], 63);
        }
        inf = dis[0][0];
        dis[x0][y0] = 0;
        
        while (l <= r) {
            int x0_val = q[l] / 1000;
            int y0_val = q[l++] % 1000;
            
            if (flag && s[x0_val][y0_val] != 0 && dis[x0_val][y0_val] <= tt && dis[x0_val][y0_val] <= dep[x0_val][y0_val]) {
                add(id, s[x0_val][y0_val], inf);
            }
            
            if (dis[x0_val][y0_val] > tt || dis[x0_val][y0_val] >= dep[x0_val][y0_val]) {
                continue;
            }
            
            if (id == 3 && s[x0_val][y0_val] == 9) {
                System.out.println(dis[x0_val][y0_val]);
            }
            
            for (int i = 0; i < 4; i++) {
                int x = x0_val + c[i][0];
                int y = y0_val + c[i][1];
                if (x > 0 && x <= n && y > 0 && y <= n && Character.isDigit(ma[x][y]) && dis[x][y] == inf) {
                    dis[x][y] = dis[x0_val][y0_val] + 1;
                    q[++r] = x * 1000 + y;
                }
            }
        }
    }

    static int[] d = new int[1000];

    static boolean build() {
        Arrays.fill(d, 0);
        int l, r;
        q[l = r = 1] = S;
        d[S] = 1;
        
        while (l <= r) {
            int x = q[l++];
            for (int i = b[x]; i != 0; i = a[i][2]) {
                int y = a[i][0];
                if (d[y] != 0 || a[i][1] == 0) {
                    continue;
                }
                d[y] = d[x] + 1;
                q[++r] = y;
                if (y == T) {
                    return true;
                }
            }
        }
        return false;
    }

    static int dinic(int x, int flow) {
        if (x == T) {
            return flow;
        }
        int k = flow;
        for (int i = b[x]; i != 0; i = a[i][2]) {
            int y = a[i][0];
            if (d[y] != d[x] + 1 || a[i][1] == 0) {
                continue;
            }
            int t = dinic(y, Math.min(k, a[i][1]));
            k -= t;
            a[i][1] -= t;
            a[i ^ 1][1] += t;
            if (k == 0) {
                return flow;
            }
        }
        if (k == flow) {
            d[x] = -1;
        }
        return flow - k;
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner scanner = new Scanner(System.in);
        n = scanner.nextInt();
        tt = scanner.nextInt();
        scanner.nextLine(); // consume newline
        
        for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
            String line = scanner.nextLine();
            ma[i] = new char[20];
            for (int j = 1; j <= n; j++) {
                ma[i][j] = line.charAt(j - 1);
            }
        }
        
        for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
            String line = scanner.nextLine();
            mb[i] = new char[20];
            for (int j = 1; j <= n; j++) {
                mb[i][j] = line.charAt(j - 1);
            }
        }
        
        for (int i = 0; i < 20; i++) {
            Arrays.fill(dep[i], 63);
        }
        
        for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
            for (int j = 1; j <= n; j++) {
                if (ma[i][j] == 'Z') {
                    bfs(i, j, false);
                }
            }
        }
        
        for (int i = 0; i < 20; i++) {
            System.arraycopy(dis[i], 0, dep[i], 0, 20);
        }
        
        int t = 1;
        S = 0;
        T = 1;
        
        for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
            for (int j = 1; j <= n; j++) {
                if (ma[i][j] > '0' && ma[i][j] <= '9') {
                    p[i][j] = ++t;
                    add(S, t, ma[i][j] - '0');
                }
                if (mb[i][j] > '0' && mb[i][j] <= '9') {
                    s[i][j] = ++t;
                    add(t, T, mb[i][j] - '0');
                }
            }
        }
        
        for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
            for (int j = 1; j <= n; j++) {
                if (p[i][j] != 0) {
                    bfs(i, j, true);
                }
            }
        }
        
        int ans = 0;
        while (build()) {
            ans += dinic(S, inf);
        }
        
        System.out.println(ans);
    }
}
